label: TPR::NTRK1

sections.text: TPR encodes a coiled-coil nuclear-pore-associated protein.
NTRK1 encodes TRKA, the nerve-growth-factor receptor tyrosine kinase.

The fusion preserves the carboxy-terminal TRK kinase domain and replaces normal receptor regulation with partner-dependent activation. TPR::NTRK1 is a reported oncogenic TRK fusion in colorectal carcinoma, with additional thyroid or mesenchymal associations.

An oncogenic NTRK fusion without a known acquired TRK resistance mutation is a larotrectinib biomarker in adults and children with advanced solid tumors after progression or without satisfactory alternatives; the indication also requires metastatic disease or surgery associated with severe morbidity.
